question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
A person may possess such vast accumulation
This wealth is set as a measure against the teaching
inference: Even wealth enough to fill the ocean with jewels is not a sufficient price for this teaching.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is read as ratnasaṃpūrṇam akartuṃ or kartum; the syntax is obscure.
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to fill the ocean with jewels.
